proposal.hypothesis: Baseline two-mode DSH candidate: registers a stable identity prompt section plus bounded candidate-owned tool and skill strategy surfaces.
proposal.expectedBehaviorChange: Expose the stable prompt section plus candidate-owned DSH tool and skill strategy in both modes.

mechanismAssertions: In solve mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:identity and the declared candidate-owned tool and skill.
In propose mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:proposal-policy and the declared candidate-owned tool and skill.
preservationAssertions: Disposing the candidate fiber removes the registered section and restores the pre-boot inventory exactly.
